title: USDA PLANTS characteristics for 534 plants, one row per plant
description:
Conservation plant characteristics, native status and distribution counts for 534 plants from the USDA PLANTS Database, with the hardiness zone band of each plant's minimum temperature.

Site built on this data: https://plant-data-sheets.at01.io/
Source repository, with columns, sources and how it was checked: https://github.com/JasonTKG/plant-data-sheets
